title: Rig Relay Symbol Codec Receipt v1
description: Content-light receipt for a deterministic symbol replacement codec operation. Contains no raw text, only hashes, counts, and codec metadata.

codec_name.description: Name of the codec used (e.g. rig.symbol_table.v1)

input_sha256.description: SHA256 hex digest of the original uncompressed text

output_sha256.description: SHA256 hex digest of the compressed text

symbol_table_sha256.description: SHA256 hex digest of the serialised symbol table

replacement_count.description: Total number of symbol replacements performed

reversible.description: Whether the codec can reconstruct the exact original text

refused_reason.description: If compression was refused, the reason. null if compression succeeded.
